story.title: Out and About in Arlington: Christmas spirit gobbles up Thanksgiving festivities
story.summary: Visit the Howell Family Farms holiday festival or browse the Texas Christkindl Market. Happy Thanksgiving weekend! Hopefully you are gobblin’ and stuffin’ yourself full of turkey — or if you’re Filipino like me, full of lechon. If you’re still looking for a way to spend time with family and friends around Arlington for the weekend, then look no further. Thanksgiving is officially behind us, which means Christmas is in full force across the city with events like the Frostival at Howell Family Farms. The walk-through experience includes a trail of lights, real reindeer, tubing slides, visits with Santa, s’mores and other forms of family-friendly festive entertainment. If you’re looking for a unique place for Christmas shopping, head to the annual Texas Christkindl Market. This German-inspired market returns to Globe Life Field daily until Dec. 23.
